profile.headline: Staff Engineer, Mobile
profile.summary: I take pride in being Innovative; in taking ownership of problems and being urgent in designing high quality and well built solutions. Delivering such results builds high trust and opens the doors to unlimited possibilities for innovation. Communication and expectation setting is key in these processes and requires a high level of integrity. I never stop learning and am always actively seeking new information about technology and engineering practices and I take pains to inspire and develop all those around me; not only leading by example but also lifting others to create the best possible teams.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Artificial Intelligence (AI) · iOS Development · Android Development · Flutter

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Leading Development Teams · Technology Leadership · Flutter · Android Development · iOS Development

positions.title: Staff Engineer, Mobile
positions.description:
Built a brand new dynamic content home page and member experience for the mobile applications based on machine learning that increased user engagement and cross-sales.

Lead the research and development of our Flutter application setting up the basic architecture and add-to-app functionality so teams could migrate from native and webviews.

Worked to increase stability of app, and provide backbone tools for everyone.

Recently worked to overhaul the Home screen again making it even more engaging and driving up our interactions by double digit percentages. Flawless roll out.

Java, Kotlin, Dart, Spring Boot, Android, Flutter, React, Java Script.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Solving difficult problems by innovating, architecting, developing, and implementing software and technology. Involved in DevOps, FrontEnd, BackEnd, and Mobile teams architecture and development.

positions.title: Software Engineering Manager
positions.description:
Working hard to bring accessible and affordable education to everyone through great products & software developed by great people.

- Managed a large number of teams and individuals as WGU continue to grow and very fast rates.
- Continued to be as hands on as possible; time permitting.
- Continued to lead in a number of areas including Mobile, Frontend, AWS, Identity & Access, and DevOps/Cloud Architecture.
- Continued to mentor, present, and train helping to establish our future goals, best practices, and strategies. Continued to establish a culture of engineering excellence.
- Took technical product/project ownership and performed solutions architecting on a number of projects and products.
- Enabled individuals to recognize their full potential and become contributors with ownership and autonomy, while encouraging mastery of craft.
- Architected, Developed, and lead development on a number of application and services

positions.title: Supervisor, Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Leading and mentoring software engineers and their teams while providing amazing technology solutions with a emphasis on Mobile (Android, iOS).

- Continued to lead and be hands on in the architecture, design and development of the mobile applications.
- Managed individuals in the team as direct reports. Handled hiring and head count budgets as well as roadmaps, goals, KPIs, and agile processes 
- Continued mentoring and growing the team into the highest performing and most successful team at WGU
- Took ownership of additions projects and teams where there were deep technical issues including Identity & Access, Leading our AWS Migration
- Ran training and development programs, presenting on new technology and going over best practices, patterns, and architectures inside WGU IT.
- Started architecting and introducing new technologies and best practices in to both our backend and our frontend development and engineering.
- Helped to define the new culture we wanted to move towards as we continued to grow.
- Architected, Developed, and lead development on a number of application and services

positions.title: Lead Senior Mobile Software Engineer
positions.description:
Creating new enterprise class mobile (Android, iOS) applications to further the capabilities of higher education.

- Designed and Architected the Android application, and solutions for mobile in general.
- Developed large number of custom widgets and views.
- Integrated with RESTful services and worked with Local Databases (SQLite) and caching.
- Ensured high performance through utilization of NIO technology and parallel multithreaded processing.
- Managed offshore Android team, built the onshore team and then managed transition to onshore team.
- Mentored individuals and helped them to grow.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Engineered, Architected, wrote, and oversaw many, many mobile applications; including medical imaging & diagnostic applications, enterprise level business applications, Enterprise level rewards applications, restaurant applications, school & sports applications, social applications and more.
Worked very closely with clients and their mobile/web software applications; consulted about their design, time requirements, functionality, best practices, and associated costs.
- Through consulting with the clients I helped to architect their mobile application, the backend API, and any web front end they needed. 
- Managed the clients projects and saw them through all phases of development while keeping the client informed. Analyzed user/customer needs and wants to determine feasibility of design requirements within given time and cost constraints.
- Headed up, was responsible for, and oversaw the production of incoming Android projects (as well as some projects from other platforms and some multi-platform projects), and the managing of the resources and engineers to see them be completed, while also doing lots of programming and development myself, and helping out in any project that was falling behind or where help was required.
- Interviewed developers for multiple positions. Supervised the work of developers; helped to maintain consistency throughout our applications, and the quality of our code through testing and code reviews.
- Mentored and trained co-workers and other developers on my team in many disciplines; especially Android and every processes involved from the start to finish of creating mobile applications.
- Repair, improve, modify, extend, and redevelop existing programs to increase operating efficiency, fix previous issues, upgrade to the customer's new vision, or adapt to new technological requirements.
- Helped create databases, write back end code, and create APIs for mobile app and web pages to interface with

positions.title: Mobile Software Developer
positions.description:
- Wrote, updated, and maintained mobile applications with many features and capabilities.
- Built everything from small to enterprise class  mobile applications
- Conducted trial runs of programs and tested software applications to be sure they would produce the desired results and that the instructions were correct.
- Modified existing mobile software to correct errors, to allow it to adapt to new hardware and devices, or to improve performance.
- Compiled and wrote documentation of program development and subsequent revisions, including inserting comments in the code so others can understand the program and the business logic.
